product.title: Private Harbor Cruise on Electric Boat in Santa Barbara

start.description: Whisper boards on the dock in front of the Santa Barbara Maritime Museum at 113 Harbor Way. Stand on the front steps of the museum & look down to where boats are docked in the water. You will see a sign for Whisper. Boarding is 5 minutes prior to departure.

end.description: Whisper boards on the dock in front of the Santa Barbara Maritime Museum at 113 Harbor Way. Stand on the front steps of the museum & look down to where boats are docked in the water. You will see a sign for Whisper. Boarding is 5 minutes prior to departure.

redemption.specialInstructions: Check in location: Whisper boards in front of the Santa Barbara Maritime Museum at 113 Harbor Way (in the harbor). Please wait on the dock, near Whisper sign 5 minutes prior to departure time

product.description:
The only all-electric Duffy charter boat in Santa Barbara. Price includes captain. Whisper is USCG certified to carry up to 6 passengers (max). Trip is fully private with your guests only. 
Bring your own appetizers, beer, and wine (no corkage fee!)
This is primarily a harbor-based cruise. When conditions are favorable, Whisper can also go out around Stearns Wharf. Boarding is 5 mins prior to departure. If you miss scheduled departure time, the tour is not extended.

inclusions.otherDescription: fully private boat ride through harbor (for up to 6 passengers)

additionalInfo.description: Public transportation options are available nearby
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

cancellationPolicy.description: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
